description: This class defines a Swing UI component 'BooleanFlagControlPanel' used to toggle a boolean configuration property for the Rusefi project. It provides UI elements like a label and checkbox, and handles sending commands and reading sensor status to synchronize the checkbox state.

classes.name: BooleanFlagControlPanel
classes.description: A Swing panel containing a label and checkbox to toggle a boolean configuration property. It can send commands when toggled and update its state based on sensor readings.

methods.name: BooleanFlagControlPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with label and checkbox captions.

methods.name: getControl
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel control containing the label and checkbox.

methods.name: installCommand
methods.description: Sets up an action listener to send a command when checkbox state changes.

methods.name: installStatusReader
methods.description: Sets up a sensor listener to update the checkbox state based on sensor readings.
